arguments.description: Search for duplicate ledger content on disk
arguments.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Continue'
Write-Output '--- files containing S1942PrePsiFive ---'
Get-ChildItem D:\lean -Recurse -Include *.md,*.txt,*.log -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-String -Pattern 'S1942PrePsiFive' -SimpleMatch -List -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 10 | ForEach-Object { $_.Path }
Write-Output '--- files containing reducedQPilotAnchor ---'
Get-ChildItem D:\lean -Recurse -Include *.md,*.txt,*.log -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-String -Pattern 'reducedQPilotAnchor' -SimpleMatch -List -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 10 | ForEach-Object { $_.Path }
Write-Output '--- git status (short) ---'
git -C D:\lean status --porcelain=v1 | Select-Object -First 30
